02 // Selected Work

Semantic Caching Layer

Live Demo ↗

An advanced semantic caching layer designed for LLMs, featuring vector similarity search with Redis HNSW index and real-time visualization of query pipeline execution. Reduces latency and API costs by matching semantically equivalent queries using embeddings.

Text-to-SQL with Guardrails

GitHub Repo ↗

A robust MVP translating natural language queries to secure SQL. Implements comprehensive safety guardrails to prevent SQL injection, restrict unauthorized schema access, and validate generated queries before execution, bridging the gap between natural language interfaces and database security.

Text-to-SQL Guardrails SQL Security Python LLM Agents

Documentation Web Crawler

GitHub Repo ↗

A high-performance, multi-threaded web crawler designed to scrape and compile complex technical documentation. Automatically manages rate limits, parses page hierarchies, and outputs clean formats (like Markdown or JSON) optimized for RAG pipelines and LLM training.

Sequence & Risk ML

GitHub Repo ↗

A collection of deep learning architectures in PyTorch for financial data: Contrastive Sequence Pre-training (CoLES) on transaction streams, SASRec event Transformers for LTV forecasting, and a Multimodal Risk Fusion model combining event sequences, tabular data, and merchant graphs for fraud detection.
